URL: https://docs.crustdata.com/general/pricing

Credits are valid for 6 months from purchase date.

Self-serve endpoint pricing:

Person endpoints:
  /person/search                    0.03 per result
  /person/search/autocomplete       Free
  /person/enrich                    1-7 per record (base 1 + addons)

Company endpoints:
  /company/search                   0.03 per result
  /company/search/autocomplete      Free
  /company/enrich                   2 per record
  /company/identify                 Free

Job endpoints:
  /job/search                       0.03 per result

Web endpoints:
  /web/search/live                  1 per query (self-serve + enterprise)
  /web/enrich/live                  1 per page   (self-serve + enterprise)

Person enrich additive pricing:
  Base profile                       1 (identity, role, location, experience, education, certifications, skills, social handles)
  Personal email data                +2
  Phone data                         +2
  Business email data                +1
  Developer platform data            +1 (platform profile, repos, orgs, activity)
  Max total: 7 credits

Common patterns:
  Base profile lookup: 1
  Sales outreach (base+business email): 2
  Full outbound (base+business email+phone): 4
  Recruiting (base+personal email+phone): 5
  Max payload: 7

Enterprise-only / plan-gated live endpoints:
  /person/professional_network/search/live    2 per profile
  /person/professional_network/enrich/live    7 per profile
  /company/professional_network/search/live   2 per company
  /job/professional_network/search/live       2 per result
  /professional_network/search/autocomplete   Free (shared live-search autocomplete when enabled)

Free endpoints:
  /person/search/autocomplete
  /company/search/autocomplete
  /company/identify
  /professional_network/search/autocomplete (enterprise only when enabled)

FAQ notes:
  - Search billed per result returned; no results = no credits.
  - Out of credits → billable requests return error.
  - Credits expire 6 months after purchase.
  - /professional_network/search/autocomplete is free but enterprise-only/plan-gated.
